title: Deep Learning-Based Welding Process Optimization and Adaptive Control Method for Welding Robots
authors: Hai-Tao Li, Tian Xiao-long, Peng Zhang, Feng Yang, Tao Wang, Ci-En Li
abstract: GMAW (gas metal arc welding) robots are frequently used in contemporary manufacturing as they offer high levels of productivity, repeatable process stability and less need for manual labour. However, even today practical robotic welding is often based upon manual design, teaching and offline programming. Welding parameters and trajectories must be redesigned whenever the workpiece, joint geometries or assembly conditions change. Furthermore, during welding, changes to the weld-seam state caused by machining error, assembly deviation and cyclic heat input result in weld parameters planned for ideal conditions becoming inadequate and the risk of incomplete fusion, porosity, cracking, slag inclusions and unstable backside formations greatly increased. In this paper a method based on deep learning is presented to provide optimization of the welding process and adaptive control for GMAW robots. This method consists of integrated quality grade oriented process planning; site-specifically improved multi-objective parameter optimization; semi-supervised semantic segmentation for the perception of weld seams and molten pools and their associated spatter suppression through neural networks predicting weld formation; and fuzzy adaptive control logic. Butt joints of Q235 carbon structural steel were tested experimentally and a response surface model was developed linking welding current, welding speed, torch angle and nozzle height to geometric properties of the welds.

infographic.key_insight: An integrated deep-learning and fuzzy-control method aims to adapt robotic GMAW parameters to changing weld-seam conditions while optimizing weld quality.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The approach targets reduced manual reprogramming and more consistent robotic welding when joint geometry, assembly conditions, or heat input vary.
method: Combine quality-grade-oriented process planning with site-specific multi-objective parameter optimization.
Use semi-supervised semantic segmentation to perceive seams and molten pools, alongside neural weld-formation prediction for spatter suppression.
Apply fuzzy adaptive control to adjust the welding process.
infographic.evidence_signal: Experiments used Q235 carbon-steel butt joints and developed a response-surface model linking current, travel speed, torch angle, and nozzle height to weld geometry; the abstract reports no quantitative performance gains.
infographic.watch_item: Transferability beyond Q235 butt joints and robustness under production conditions require further validation.
infographic.paper_title: Deep Learning-Based Welding Process Optimization and Adaptive Control Method for Welding Robots

zh-Hans.title: 基于深度学习的焊接机器人焊接工艺优化与自适应控制方法
zh-Hans.abstract: GMAW（熔化极气体保护电弧焊）机器人因具有生产率高、工艺稳定性可重复、人工需求较少等优势，在现代制造业中得到广泛应用。然而，即使在今天，实际机器人焊接仍往往依赖人工设计、示教和离线编程。每当工件、接头几何形状或装配条件发生变化时，都必须重新设计焊接参数和轨迹。此外，在焊接过程中，加工误差、装配偏差和周期性热输入引起的焊缝状态变化，会使针对理想条件规划的焊接参数不再适用，并大幅增加未熔合、气孔、裂纹、夹渣以及背面成形不稳定的风险。本文提出了一种基于深度学习的方法，用于GMAW机器人的焊接工艺优化与自适应控制。该方法集成了面向质量等级的工艺规划、针对现场情况改进的多目标参数优化、用于焊缝和熔池感知的半监督语义分割及利用焊缝成形预测神经网络实现的相关飞溅抑制，以及模糊自适应控制逻辑。研究对Q235碳素结构钢对接接头进行了实验测试，并建立了将焊接电流、焊接速度、焊枪角度和喷嘴高度与焊缝几何特性相关联的响应面模型。

infographic.key_insight: 一种集成深度学习与模糊控制的方法，旨在使机器人GMAW参数适应不断变化的焊缝状态，同时优化焊接质量。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该方法旨在减少人工重新编程，并在接头几何形状、装配条件或热输入发生变化时，提高机器人焊接的一致性。
method: 将面向质量等级的工艺规划与针对现场情况的多目标参数优化相结合。
利用半监督语义分割感知焊缝和熔池，同时利用神经网络预测焊缝成形以抑制飞溅。
应用模糊自适应控制来调整焊接过程。
infographic.evidence_signal: 实验采用Q235碳钢对接接头，并建立了将电流、焊接速度、焊枪角度和喷嘴高度与焊缝几何形状相关联的响应面模型；摘要未报告定量的性能提升。
infographic.watch_item: 该方法对Q235对接接头以外对象的可迁移性，以及在生产条件下的鲁棒性，仍需进一步验证。

title: Interpretable ensemble learning for tensile strength prediction and welding process window optimization of friction stir-welded 7N01 aluminum alloy
authors: Xiaocui Wu, Yingjie Zhao, Huijie Zhang, Qi Cheng, Limao Wei, Yuwang Liu
abstract: This study aims to achieve high-accuracy prediction of the ultimate tensile strength (UTS) of friction stir-welded A7N01P-T4 aluminum alloy joints, elucidate the effects of welding parameters on UTS, and optimize the welding process window. Rotational speed, welding speed, and shoulder plunge depth were used as input variables, with UTS as the output. Machine learning models were developed using 27 experimental samples and evaluated by leave-one-out cross-validation. Comparison of decision tree, K-nearest neighbors, and Gaussian process regression identifies decision tree as the best baseline model, with an R 2 of 0.905. An ensemble learning strategy was subsequently introduced to construct a gradient boosting decision tree, increasing R 2 to 0.966, and grid search optimization of its key hyperparameters further improves R 2 to 0.978. SHapley Additive exPlanations analysis shows that the importance of the welding parameters follows the order of welding speed, rotational speed, and shoulder plunge depth, and the identified parameter effects agree well with the experimental results and observed microstructural evolution. The optimized model predicts fully feasible ranges of all the welding parameters for a joint efficiency of at least 90%, and the shoulder plunge depth acts as a key parameter for further refining the high-strength welding process window. These results demonstrate that the proposed approach not only improves the accuracy of UTS prediction but also reveals welding parameter effects and enables optimization of the welding process window, providing a quantitative basis for selecting FSW parameters.
venue: Journal of Materials Research and Technology

infographic.key_insight: Optimized gradient boosting predicts friction stir-welded 7N01 aluminum joint strength with R² = 0.978 and identifies process windows targeting at least 90% joint efficiency.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The model provides a quantitative basis for selecting welding parameters, with shoulder plunge depth helping refine the high-strength process window.
method: Predict ultimate tensile strength from rotational speed, welding speed, and shoulder plunge depth.
Compare baseline models, then tune gradient boosting decision trees using grid search.
Use SHAP to interpret parameter effects and map predicted high-strength process windows.

infographic.paper_title: Interpretable ensemble learning for tensile strength prediction and welding process window optimization of friction stir-welded 7N01 aluminum alloy

zh-Hans.title: 用于搅拌摩擦焊7N01铝合金抗拉强度预测与焊接工艺窗口优化的可解释集成学习
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究旨在高精度预测搅拌摩擦焊A7N01P-T4铝合金接头的极限抗拉强度（UTS），阐明焊接参数对UTS的影响，并优化焊接工艺窗口。以旋转速度、焊接速度和轴肩下压量为输入变量，以UTS为输出。利用27个实验样本建立机器学习模型，并通过留一交叉验证进行评估。对决策树、K近邻和高斯过程回归进行比较，确定决策树为最佳基准模型，其R²为0.905。随后引入集成学习策略构建梯度提升决策树，将R²提高至0.966，并通过网格搜索优化其关键超参数，进一步将R²提高至0.978。SHapley加性解释（SHAP）分析表明，焊接参数的重要性依次为焊接速度、旋转速度和轴肩下压量，且所识别的参数影响与实验结果及观察到的微观组织演变吻合良好。优化后的模型预测了接头效率至少为90%时所有焊接参数的完全可行范围，而轴肩下压量是进一步细化高强度焊接工艺窗口的关键参数。这些结果表明，所提出的方法不仅提高了UTS预测精度，还揭示了焊接参数的影响，并实现了焊接工艺窗口的优化，为搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）参数的选择提供了定量依据。

infographic.key_insight: 优化后的梯度提升模型以R² = 0.978的精度预测搅拌摩擦焊7N01铝合金接头强度，并识别出以接头效率至少达到90%为目标的工艺窗口。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该模型为焊接参数的选择提供了定量依据，其中轴肩下压量有助于细化高强度工艺窗口。
method: 根据旋转速度、焊接速度和轴肩下压量预测极限抗拉强度。
比较基准模型，然后利用网格搜索对梯度提升决策树进行调优。
使用SHAP解释参数影响，并绘制预测的高强度工艺窗口。
infographic.evidence_signal: 基于27个实验样本和留一交叉验证，所报告的R²从决策树的0.905提高至梯度提升模型的0.966，并在调优后达到0.978。

title: Microstructure and surface performance of detonation gun sprayed 80Ni20Cr and NiCrAlY coatings on Al 6061-T6 substrate for structural applications
authors: T. Sampath kumar, Rajaram Ganesan, M.M. Reddy
abstract: Two protective coatings, 80Ni20Cr and NiCrAlY, were deposited on Al 6061-T6 alloy substrates using the Detonation Gun (D-Gun) thermal spray process. The deposited coatings were studied for their microstructure, phase composition, surface roughness, hardness, corrosion behaviour, wettability, and solid particle erosion resistance. Characterisation was done using SEM-EDS, XRD, AFM, nanoindentation, potentiodynamic polarisation, contact angle measurement, and erosion testing. SEM-EDS results showed that both coatings bonded well to the substrate with uniform thickness. The NiCrAlY coating had a denser microstructure with lower porosity compared to 80Ni20Cr. XRD identified CrNi phases with FCC crystal structure in 80Ni20Cr and Al₂NiY phases with orthorhombic structure in NiCrAlY. Nanocrystalline grain structure was observed in both coatings. AFM measurements showed that NiCrAlY had the lowest surface roughness among all three samples. Nanoindentation results showed that NiCrAlY hardness is approximately 10 times higher than 80Ni20Cr. Specifically, NiCrAlY showed a hardness of 7895.36 MPa (731.2 HV), compared with 780.11 MPa (72.25 HV) for 80Ni20Cr and 708.68 MPa for the uncoated Al 6061 substrate. Potentiodynamic polarisation tests in 3.5 wt% NaCl solution confirmed that NiCrAlY recorded the lowest corrosion current density of 6.625 × 10 -7 A/cm² and a corrosion rate of 0.00567 mmpy. The 80Ni20Cr coating gave a corrosion current density of 1.585 × 10 - 6 A/cm² and a corrosion rate of 0.01427 mmpy. Both figures are considerably lower than the bare substrate at 0.5185 mmpy. Contact angle measurements confirmed superhydrophobic behaviour for NiCrAlY and near-superhydrophobic behaviour for 80Ni20Cr. Solid particle erosion test results showed that 80Ni20Cr recorded the lowest mass loss. Under the laboratory conditions used (3.5 wt% NaCl at room temperature; a single erosion condition of 90° impact angle, 40 m/s and 5 min), NiCrAlY showed the better hardness and corrosion resistance, whereas 80Ni20Cr showed the better erosion resistance. These results indicate relative performance under the test conditions and are not a prediction of long-term service life.

infographic.key_insight: D-Gun-sprayed NiCrAlY provided higher hardness and better corrosion resistance on Al 6061-T6, while 80Ni20Cr showed better solid-particle erosion resistance.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Coating selection should match the dominant damage mechanism: NiCrAlY for hardness and saline corrosion resistance, or 80Ni20Cr for erosion under the tested conditions.
method: Deposited 80Ni20Cr and NiCrAlY coatings on Al 6061-T6 using detonation gun thermal spraying.
Characterised microstructure, phases, roughness and hardness using SEM-EDS, XRD, AFM and nanoindentation.
Evaluated saline corrosion, wettability and solid-particle erosion.

infographic.watch_item: Room-temperature corrosion tests in 3.5 wt% NaCl and one erosion condition (90° impact, 40 m/s, 5 min) do not establish long-term service performance.
infographic.paper_title: Microstructure and surface performance of detonation gun sprayed 80Ni20Cr and NiCrAlY coatings on Al 6061-T6 substrate for structural applications

zh-Hans.title: 面向结构应用的 Al 6061-T6 基体上爆炸喷涂 80Ni20Cr 和 NiCrAlY 涂层的微观组织与表面性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 采用爆炸喷涂（D-Gun）热喷涂工艺，在 Al 6061-T6 合金基体上沉积了 80Ni20Cr 和 NiCrAlY 两种防护涂层。研究了所沉积涂层的微观组织、物相组成、表面粗糙度、硬度、腐蚀行为、润湿性及抗固体颗粒冲蚀性能。采用 SEM-EDS、XRD、AFM、纳米压痕、动电位极化、接触角测量和冲蚀试验进行表征。SEM-EDS 结果表明，两种涂层均与基体结合良好，且厚度均匀。与 80Ni20Cr 相比，NiCrAlY 涂层的微观组织更致密，孔隙率更低。XRD 在 80Ni20Cr 中鉴定出具有面心立方（FCC）晶体结构的 CrNi 相，在 NiCrAlY 中鉴定出具有正交晶体结构的 Al₂NiY 相。两种涂层中均观察到纳米晶组织。AFM 测量表明，在全部三个样品中，NiCrAlY 的表面粗糙度最低。纳米压痕结果表明，NiCrAlY 的硬度约为 80Ni20Cr 的 10 倍。具体而言，NiCrAlY 的硬度为 7895.36 MPa（731.2 HV），80Ni20Cr 的硬度为 780.11 MPa（72.25 HV），而未涂覆的 Al 6061 基体硬度为 708.68 MPa。在 3.5 wt% NaCl 溶液中进行的动电位极化试验证实，NiCrAlY 的腐蚀电流密度最低，为 6.625 × 10⁻⁷ A/cm²，腐蚀速率为 0.00567 mmpy。80Ni20Cr 涂层的腐蚀电流密度为 1.585 × 10⁻⁶ A/cm²，腐蚀速率为 0.01427 mmpy。两种涂层的腐蚀速率均显著低于裸基体的 0.5185 mmpy。接触角测量证实，NiCrAlY 具有超疏水性，80Ni20Cr 具有接近超疏水的特性。固体颗粒冲蚀试验结果表明，80Ni20Cr 的质量损失最低。在所采用的实验室条件下（室温下的 3.5 wt% NaCl 溶液；冲击角度为 90°、速度为 40 m/s、持续时间为 5 min 的单一冲蚀工况），NiCrAlY 表现出更高的硬度和更好的耐腐蚀性，而 80Ni20Cr 表现出更好的抗冲蚀性。这些结果反映的是试验条件下的相对性能，并非对长期服役寿命的预测。

infographic.key_insight: 在 Al 6061-T6 上，D-Gun 喷涂的 NiCrAlY 具有更高的硬度和更好的耐腐蚀性，而 80Ni20Cr 表现出更好的抗固体颗粒冲蚀性能。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 涂层选择应与主导损伤机制相匹配：若侧重硬度和盐水腐蚀耐受性，可选择 NiCrAlY；若侧重所测试条件下的抗冲蚀性，可选择 80Ni20Cr。
method: 采用爆炸喷涂热喷涂工艺，在 Al 6061-T6 上沉积 80Ni20Cr 和 NiCrAlY 涂层。
采用 SEM-EDS、XRD、AFM 和纳米压痕表征微观组织、物相、粗糙度及硬度。
评估盐水腐蚀行为、润湿性及固体颗粒冲蚀性能。
infographic.evidence_signal: NiCrAlY 的硬度达到 7895.36 MPa，而 80Ni20Cr 为 780.11 MPa；两者的腐蚀速率分别为 0.00567 和 0.01427 mm/年，裸铝的腐蚀速率则为 0.5185 mm/年。
infographic.watch_item: 室温下在 3.5 wt% NaCl 溶液中进行的腐蚀试验，以及单一冲蚀工况（90° 冲击角度、40 m/s、5 min）的试验，无法确定长期服役性能。

title: ANALYSIS OF FACTORS AFFECTING WELD QUALITY IN INDUSTRIAL EQUIPMENT MANUFACTURING: AN ISHIKAWA-BASED APPROACH
authors: Fernando César Zanco, Vinicius Pereira Campos, Undergraduate Student In Mechanical Engineering, Willian Ricardo Dias da Silva, Mario Vinicio Garcia, Roberto Moraes Cruz
abstract: Welding quality is a critical factor in industrial equipment manufacturing, directly influencing structural integrity, operational reliability, and component safety. However, welding discontinuities may result from the interaction of technical, operational, organizational, and environmental factors, requiring integrated preventive quality management approaches. This study aims to analyze the main factors influencing weld quality in industrial equipment manufacturing, systematically classifying potential causes of discontinuities and identifying preventive measures based on technical standards. The research adopts a qualitative, exploratory, and descriptive approach, supported by a literature review and documentary analysis of welding quality standards, particularly the ABNT NBR ISO 3834 series. The Ishikawa Diagram, structured according to the 6M framework, was employed to classify potential causes into Method, Machine, Material, Manpower, Measurement, and Environment. The findings identified five major welding discontinuities: porosity, cracks, lack of fusion, incomplete penetration, and undercut. The analysis indicates that these discontinuities may arise from interconnected process conditions, emphasizing the importance of standardized procedures, equipment monitoring, appropriate material handling, personnel qualification, and systematic inspection. The study contributes an integrated analytical framework linking welding discontinuities, potential causal factors, and preventive control measures. It concludes that combining technical standardization with quality management tools may support preventive decision-making and continuous improvement in industrial welding processes, although empirical validation remains necessary.

infographic.key_insight: An Ishikawa 6M framework links five major welding discontinuities to interconnected process factors and preventive controls.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The framework can guide welding quality management to support structural integrity, equipment reliability, and component safety.
method: Qualitative literature review and documentary analysis, emphasizing ABNT NBR ISO 3834.
Classify potential causes by Method, Machine, Material, Manpower, Measurement, and Environment.

zh-Hans.title: 工业设备制造中影响焊接质量的因素分析：基于石川图的方法
zh-Hans.abstract: 焊接质量是工业设备制造中的关键因素，直接影响结构完整性、运行可靠性和部件安全性。然而，焊接不连续性可能由技术、操作、组织和环境因素的相互作用引起，因此需要采用综合性的预防性质量管理方法。本研究旨在分析工业设备制造中影响焊接质量的主要因素，系统地对不连续性的潜在成因进行分类，并依据技术标准确定预防措施。本研究采用定性、探索性和描述性研究方法，以文献综述和焊接质量标准的文件分析为支撑，重点关注 ABNT NBR ISO 3834 系列标准。研究采用按 6M 框架构建的石川图，将潜在成因分为方法、机器、材料、人员、测量和环境六类。研究结果识别出五种主要焊接不连续性：气孔、裂纹、未熔合、未焊透和咬边。分析表明，这些不连续性可能源于相互关联的工艺条件，凸显了标准化规程、设备监测、适当的材料处理、人员资格评定和系统性检验的重要性。本研究提出了一个综合分析框架，将焊接不连续性、潜在致因和预防性控制措施联系起来。研究得出结论，将技术标准化与质量管理工具相结合，可能有助于工业焊接过程中的预防性决策和持续改进，但仍需进行实证验证。

infographic.watch_item: 在假定能够减少缺陷之前，应在实际生产条件下验证所提出的因果联系和预防性控制措施。

title: Study on the transition behavior and forming process of oscillating laser double-wire welding of aluminum alloy
authors: Xiaoxu Li, Quanda Zhang, Dandan Zhao, Zizhi Liu, Wenhao Huang
abstract: To achieve high-quality and high-stability weld formation in aluminum alloys, this study investigates the dynamic evolution of the molten pool and droplet transfer behavior during oscillating laser double-wire welding. Particular emphasis is placed on the coupled effects of process parameters—including laser power, laser oscillation parameters (frequency, amplitude, and trajectory), and wire feeding speed—on molten-pool morphology and weld quality. By employing high-speed imaging technology, the surface flow of the molten pool, droplet transfer, and metal filling behavior were captured in real time, revealing the influence of oscillation parameters on the stability of weld formation. Research indicates that different laser oscillation patterns—such as circular, ∞-shaped, and figure-eight trajectories—significantly modify the spatial distribution and fluctuation period of heat-source energy within the molten pool, thereby influencing the pool’s responsiveness to external energy input and material feed. A well-designed oscillation trajectory can effectively enhance convective flow within the molten pool and improve the stability of droplet transfer. This research further aims to construct a mapping relationship between droplet transfer and molten-pool response under various process parameters, and to establish a multifactor coupled model of “energy input–molten pool behavior-forming quality” providing both theoretical support and experimental evidence for high-precision control and process optimization in oscillating laser double-wire welding.

infographic.key_insight: Laser oscillation trajectories shape molten-pool heat distribution and flow, with well-designed paths improving droplet-transfer and weld-formation stability in aluminum double-wire welding.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Coordinating laser power, oscillation settings, and wire feed offers a route to more stable, high-quality aluminum welds.
method: Investigate coupled effects of laser power, oscillation frequency, amplitude, trajectory, and wire-feed speed.
Use high-speed imaging to observe molten-pool surface flow, droplet transfer, and metal filling.
Compare oscillation paths and seek links between energy input, pool behavior, and forming quality.

infographic.watch_item: The coupled model remains a stated research aim, and the abstract does not demonstrate AI-based optimization or validated process-control performance.

zh-Hans.title: 铝合金摆动激光双丝焊接过渡行为与成形过程研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 为实现铝合金焊缝的高质量、高稳定性成形，本研究探讨了摆动激光双丝焊接过程中熔池的动态演化及熔滴过渡行为。重点关注激光功率、激光摆动参数（频率、振幅和轨迹）以及送丝速度等工艺参数对熔池形态和焊缝质量的耦合影响。采用高速成像技术，实时捕捉熔池表面流动、熔滴过渡和金属填充行为，揭示摆动参数对焊缝成形稳定性的影响。研究表明，圆形、∞形和8字形等不同激光摆动轨迹会显著改变熔池内热源能量的空间分布和波动周期，进而影响熔池对外部能量输入和材料送进的响应特性。合理设计的摆动轨迹能够有效增强熔池内的对流，并提高熔滴过渡的稳定性。本研究进一步旨在构建不同工艺参数下熔滴过渡与熔池响应之间的映射关系，建立“能量输入—熔池行为—成形质量”多因素耦合模型，为摆动激光双丝焊接的高精度控制和工艺优化提供理论支撑与实验依据。

infographic.key_insight: 激光摆动轨迹影响熔池内的热量分布与流动，合理设计的轨迹可提高铝合金双丝焊接中熔滴过渡和焊缝成形的稳定性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 协调激光功率、摆动设置和送丝参数，为获得更稳定、更高质量的铝合金焊缝提供了一条途径。
method: 研究激光功率、摆动频率、振幅、轨迹及送丝速度的耦合影响。
采用高速成像技术观察熔池表面流动、熔滴过渡和金属填充。
比较不同摆动轨迹，探寻能量输入、熔池行为与成形质量之间的联系。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了实时高速成像观测结果，并定性描述了熔池行为随轨迹变化的情况，但未提供数值化性能指标。
infographic.watch_item: 耦合模型仍属于所述研究目标，摘要未展示基于人工智能的优化，也未展示经过验证的工艺控制性能。

title: Fatigue strength improvement of gusset end detail with welding techniques
authors: Kalle Lipiäinen, Sami Heinilä, Antti Ahola, Tuomas Skriko
abstract: Abstract Gusset end details are usually welded-around with fillet welds leading to high structural and notch stress concentrations. Under cyclic loads, these structural details are usually prone to fatigue failures. This study investigates an extended welding technique and post-weld treatment to enhance the fatigue strength of welded-around gusset end details. Experimental fatigue tests are carried out on welded coupon specimens made of S420 structural steel to screen the applicability of different welding techniques and post-weld treatment techniques. A novel multi-pass welding technique – featuring weld stop locations extended further away from the joint region, along with TIG dressing weld stop location notches – was found to substantially enhance fatigue strength compared to welded-around gussets. This configuration was selected for further experimental testing, and characteristic S – N curves were determined using uniaxial constant amplitude fatigue testing with the applied stress ratio of R = 0.1. The characteristic fatigue strength of Δ σ c,97.7% = 127 MPa (slope parameter of m = 5) was obtained based on experimental testing. Further validation of the applicability of the obtained fatigue strength for the in-service variable amplitude loading was carried out by fatigue testing similar joints with variable amplitude block loading at the high-cycle fatigue regime. The results highlight the potential of such extended welding techniques for increasing the fatigue performance of gusset end details. When transforming the results to high mean stress conditions ( R = 0.5), and accounting for typical structural stress concentration of the studied gusset end detail, FAT90 ( m = 5) could be utilized for design purposes based on preliminary finite-element analysis.

infographic.key_insight: Extending multi-pass weld stops away from the gusset joint and TIG-dressing their notches substantially improved fatigue strength over conventional welded-around details.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The technique offers a route to more fatigue-resistant gusset connections, with FAT90 (m = 5) suggested for design under high mean stress based on preliminary analysis.
method: Screened welding and post-weld treatment techniques on S420 steel coupon specimens.
Established characteristic S–N curves using uniaxial constant-amplitude tests at R = 0.1.
Evaluated the selected joint configuration under variable-amplitude block loading in the high-cycle regime.
infographic.evidence_signal: Experimental testing yielded a characteristic fatigue strength of 127 MPa at 97.7% survival probability with slope m = 5; variable-amplitude tests further assessed applicability.
infographic.watch_item: The FAT90 design recommendation relies on transformation to R = 0.5 and preliminary finite-element estimates of structural stress concentration.
infographic.paper_title: Fatigue strength improvement of gusset end detail with welding techniques

zh-Hans.title: 采用焊接技术提高节点板端部构造的疲劳强度
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 节点板端部构造通常采用角焊缝围焊，导致较高的结构应力集中和缺口应力集中。在循环荷载作用下，这些结构细节通常容易发生疲劳破坏。本研究考察了用于提高围焊节点板端部构造疲劳强度的焊缝延伸技术和焊后处理方法。通过对S420结构钢焊接试样开展疲劳试验，筛选不同焊接技术和焊后处理技术的适用性。研究发现，与围焊节点板相比，一种新型多道焊技术可显著提高疲劳强度；该技术将焊缝收弧位置延伸至距接头区域更远处，并采用TIG修整收弧位置的缺口。研究选取这一构造开展进一步试验，并通过应力比R = 0.1的单轴等幅疲劳试验确定了特征S–N曲线。试验得到的特征疲劳强度为Δ σ c,97.7% = 127 MPa（斜率参数m = 5）。通过在高周疲劳范围内对类似接头施加变幅块荷载并开展疲劳试验，进一步验证了所得疲劳强度对服役变幅荷载的适用性。结果表明，此类焊缝延伸技术具有提高节点板端部构造疲劳性能的潜力。基于初步有限元分析，将结果换算至高平均应力条件（R = 0.5），并计入所研究节点板端部构造的典型结构应力集中后，可采用FAT90（m = 5）进行设计。

infographic.key_insight: 将多道焊的收弧位置延伸至远离节点板接头的区域，并采用TIG修整这些位置的缺口，可使疲劳强度较传统围焊构造显著提高。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该技术为提高节点板连接的抗疲劳性能提供了一种途径；基于初步分析，建议在高平均应力条件下采用FAT90（m = 5）进行设计。
method: 在S420钢试样上筛选焊接技术和焊后处理技术。
通过R = 0.1的单轴等幅试验建立特征S–N曲线。
在高周疲劳范围内，通过变幅块荷载评估所选接头构造。
infographic.evidence_signal: 试验得到在97.7%存活概率下的特征疲劳强度为127 MPa，斜率m = 5；变幅试验进一步评估了其适用性。
infographic.watch_item: FAT90设计建议依赖于向R = 0.5条件的换算，以及对结构应力集中的初步有限元估算。

title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene
authors: A. Alhourani, I. Barsoum, J. Sheikh-Ahmad, S. Deveci
abstract: Friction stir welding (FSW) has gained recognition as an effective technique for joining thermoplastic materials. This study presents a comprehensive investigation to predict FSW characteristics such as weld temperatures, vertical axial forces, material flow and defect formation in FSW of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) using both computational and machine learning approaches, validated by experimental results. A three-dimensional Coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) numerical model is developed to simulate the HDPE welding process under varying process parameters of rotational and welding speeds, and bottom preheating conditions. The CEL numerical model is validated against experimental data, showing markedly good agreement in predicting void formation, thermal and mechanical responses. Results indicate that preheating the bottom surface proved effective in reducing thermal gradients and stabilizing vertical force fluctuations. Quantitatively, bottom-surface preheating at 60 °C reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N close to 1100 N and raised peak temperatures from 70 °C (without preheat) to about 100 °C, hence smoothing through-thickness gradients and stabilizing the axial force distribution. In parallel, two multilayer perceptron artificial neural networks (ANNs) are trained on experimental data to predict temporal temperature and axial force responses with R2 between 0.91 and 0.99, demonstrating high accuracy and strong generalization across the tested FSW parameter space. The computational CEL simulations accurately predicted weld zone morphology, including stir zone, thermo-mechanically affected zone and heat-affected zone, however the combined CEL–ANN framework enables rapid generation of process maps that highlights defective and defect-free welding windows, with optimal conditions obtained at 1500 rpm and 30 mm/min with 60 °C preheating, and poor weldability observed at 1000 rpm without preheating due to wormhole formation. These findings provide process-driven design guidelines for developing robust HDPE joints and demonstrate how integrating computational modeling with machine learning enables efficient optimization, offering valuable insights into the key characteristics of the FSW process in thermoplastics and supporting its broader adoption in industrial applications.

infographic.key_insight: Combining physics-based simulation and neural networks mapped HDPE friction stir welding quality, identifying 1500 rpm, 30 mm/min and 60 °C bottom preheating as optimal among the tested conditions.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Bottom preheating can reduce plunge loads and thermal gradients, helping engineers select more stable welding conditions and avoid void defects.
method: Simulated temperature, axial force, material flow and defects using a 3D Coupled Eulerian–Lagrangian model.
Trained two multilayer perceptron neural networks on experimental temperature and axial-force histories.
Used the combined modelling framework to map defective and defect-free process windows.
infographic.evidence_signal: Experimental validation supported the simulations; ANN predictions achieved R² values of 0.91–0.99, while 60 °C preheating reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N to approximately 1100 N.
infographic.watch_item: Accuracy is demonstrated within the tested parameter space; transfer to other HDPE grades, tool geometries or operating ranges requires further validation.
infographic.paper_title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene

zh-Hans.title: 用于预测高密度聚乙烯搅拌摩擦焊焊接质量的计算建模与机器学习建模方法
zh-Hans.abstract: 搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）已被公认为一种连接热塑性材料的有效技术。本研究采用计算建模与机器学习方法，对高密度聚乙烯（HDPE）搅拌摩擦焊中的焊接温度、垂直轴向力、材料流动和缺陷形成等特征开展了全面的预测研究，并通过实验结果进行验证。研究建立了三维耦合欧拉–拉格朗日（CEL）数值模型，以模拟不同转速、焊接速度和底部预热条件下的HDPE焊接过程。CEL数值模型通过实验数据验证，在预测孔洞形成以及热响应和力学响应方面均表现出很高的一致性。结果表明，底面预热能够有效减小温度梯度并抑制垂直力波动。定量而言，60 °C底面预热使峰值下压力从1600 N降至接近1100 N，并使峰值温度从未预热时的70 °C升至约100 °C，从而减缓厚度方向的温度梯度，并使轴向力分布趋于稳定。与此同时，研究利用实验数据训练了两个多层感知器人工神经网络（ANN），用于预测温度和轴向力随时间的响应，R2介于0.91和0.99之间，表明其在所测试的FSW参数空间内具有较高精度和较强泛化能力。CEL计算模拟准确预测了焊接区域的形貌，包括搅拌区、热机械影响区和热影响区；而CEL–ANN组合框架能够快速生成工艺图谱，标示有缺陷和无缺陷的焊接工艺窗口。其中，在1500 rpm、30 mm/min和60 °C预热条件下获得了最佳工况，而在1000 rpm且未预热时，由于形成虫孔缺陷，观察到较差的可焊性。这些发现为制备可靠的HDPE接头提供了以工艺为导向的设计指南，并展示了计算建模与机器学习相结合如何实现高效优化，为理解热塑性材料FSW工艺的关键特征提供了有价值的见解，并支持其在工业应用中的更广泛采用。

infographic.key_insight: 结合基于物理的模拟与神经网络，研究绘制了HDPE搅拌摩擦焊质量图谱，并确定在所测试条件中，1500 rpm、30 mm/min和60 °C底部预热为最佳工况。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 底部预热可降低下压载荷和温度梯度，帮助工程师选择更稳定的焊接条件并避免孔洞缺陷。
method: 使用三维耦合欧拉–拉格朗日模型模拟温度、轴向力、材料流动和缺陷。
利用实验测得的温度和轴向力时间历程训练两个多层感知器神经网络。
使用组合建模框架绘制有缺陷和无缺陷的工艺窗口。
infographic.evidence_signal: 实验验证支持了模拟结果；ANN预测的R²值达到0.91–0.99，而60 °C预热使峰值下压力从1600 N降至约1100 N。
infographic.watch_item: 预测精度已在所测试的参数空间内得到验证；推广至其他HDPE牌号、工具几何形状或运行范围仍需进一步验证。

title: Detection of Separator Contact Defects Using Spectroscopic Signals and Deep Learning in Copper Laser Welding for Lithium-Ion Batteries
authors: Donghyeon Yun, Yeong Gil Jo, Jaewon Yang, Minjung Kang
abstract: Separator contact during laser welding of lithium-ion battery cells can cause thermal damage and safety issues. This study investigated whether spectroscopic signals could be used to distinguish normal welds from separator contact defects and evaluated the effects of spectrometer configuration and deep learning models on defect classification performance. A spectrometer-based monitoring system was established, and the signal characteristics were analyzed according to fiber core diameter, slit width, optical configuration, and integration time. Based on the optimized spectrometer conditions, deep learning models including LSTM, GRU, CNN, TCN, and CNN+LSTM were trained using both characteristic wavelength ranges (350-450 and 650-750 nm) and the full spectral range (232-1110 nm). Models trained with the characteristic wavelength ranges achieved separator F1-scores of 0.87-0.88, whereas those trained with the full spectral range achieved F1-scores of 0.91-0.99. Among the evaluated models, LSTM showed the best performance with an F1-score of 0.99. These results demonstrate that a spectrometer configuration combined with deep learning provides an effective approach for the detection of separator contact during laser welding.

infographic.key_insight: Full-spectrum deep learning detected separator contact defects during copper laser welding, with LSTM achieving the highest reported separator F1-score of 0.99.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Spectroscopic monitoring could help identify separator contact that risks thermal damage and safety issues in lithium-ion battery production.
method: Evaluated fiber core diameter, slit width, optical configuration, and integration time for spectroscopic monitoring.
Trained LSTM, GRU, CNN, TCN, and CNN+LSTM models to classify normal welds and separator contact defects.
Compared characteristic wavelength bands (350–450 and 650–750 nm) with the full spectrum (232–1110 nm).
infographic.evidence_signal: Separator F1-scores were 0.87–0.88 for characteristic wavelength bands and 0.91–0.99 for the full spectrum.
infographic.watch_item: The abstract does not report dataset size or independent production-line validation, leaving deployment generalization uncertain.
infographic.paper_title: Detection of Separator Contact Defects Using Spectroscopic Signals and Deep Learning in Copper Laser Welding for Lithium-Ion Batteries

zh-Hans.title: 利用光谱信号和深度学习检测锂离子电池铜材激光焊接中的隔膜接触缺陷
zh-Hans.abstract: 锂离子电池电芯激光焊接过程中发生隔膜接触可能导致热损伤和安全问题。本研究探讨了能否利用光谱信号区分正常焊缝与隔膜接触缺陷，并评估了光谱仪配置和深度学习模型对缺陷分类性能的影响。研究建立了基于光谱仪的监测系统，并分析了不同光纤芯径、狭缝宽度、光学配置和积分时间下的信号特征。在优化后的光谱仪条件下，分别使用特征波长范围（350-450 和 650-750 nm）及全光谱范围（232-1110 nm）的数据，训练了 LSTM、GRU、CNN、TCN 和 CNN+LSTM 等深度学习模型。使用特征波长范围训练的模型对隔膜接触缺陷的 F1 分数为 0.87-0.88，而使用全光谱范围训练的模型的 F1 分数为 0.91-0.99。在所评估的模型中，LSTM 表现最佳，F1 分数达到 0.99。这些结果表明，光谱仪配置与深度学习相结合，为检测激光焊接过程中的隔膜接触提供了一种有效方法。

infographic.key_insight: 全光谱深度学习可检测铜材激光焊接过程中的隔膜接触缺陷，其中 LSTM 对隔膜接触缺陷的 F1 分数达到所报告的最高值 0.99。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 光谱监测有望帮助识别锂离子电池生产中可能导致热损伤和安全问题的隔膜接触。
method: 评估了用于光谱监测的光纤芯径、狭缝宽度、光学配置和积分时间。
训练了 LSTM、GRU、CNN、TCN 和 CNN+LSTM 模型，以对正常焊缝和隔膜接触缺陷进行分类。
infographic.evidence_signal: 使用特征波段时，隔膜接触缺陷的 F1 分数为 0.87–0.88；使用全光谱时，该分数为 0.91–0.99。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要未报告数据集规模或独立生产线验证情况，因此实际部署中的泛化能力仍不确定。

title: Welding of thermoplastics printed by fused filament fabrication: A critical review of joining mechanisms and relationships between processing, structure, and properties
authors: Rahmat Azis Nabawi, Dani Harmanto, Febri Prasetya, Yogi Dian Alfana
abstract: Fused filament fabrication (FFF) technology, also known as fused deposition modeling (FDM), enables the production of thermoplastic components with complex geometries, but remains limited by the printer’s build volume. Welding can join separately printed components. However, layered structures, infill configurations, porosity, and interlayer bonding affect joint formation and strength. This article critically reviews six welding techniques for FFF-printed thermoplastic components: friction stir welding, friction stir spot welding, rotary friction welding, ultrasonic welding, laser joining, and microwave-assisted welding. The review focuses on joining mechanisms, process parameters, material characteristics, mechanical performance, and failure mechanisms. The results indicate that joint quality depends on the interaction among welding parameters, polymer type, infill structure, tool or interface design, and joint configuration. Increasing process energy does not always improve joint strength because excessive heating can cause thermal degradation and deformation, while insufficient material consolidation can limit joint integrity. Direct comparisons between techniques are still limited by differences in materials, specimen geometries, joint configurations, and testing methods. Evidence regarding microwave-assisted welding for joining separately printed components is also still limited. Future research needs to integrate printing and welding parameters, correlate structural characteristics and defects with mechanical performance, and improve the consistency of testing and reporting. Such an approach is necessary to clarify the relationships between process, structure, and properties and to support the development of reliable joints for engineering applications.

infographic.key_insight: Weld quality in FFF-printed thermoplastics depends on coupled processing, material, and printed-structure effects—not simply higher energy input.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Welding can enable assemblies beyond printer build-volume limits, but reliable joints require coordinated printing and joining design.
method: Critically reviews six welding techniques for FFF-printed thermoplastics.
Examines joining mechanisms, process parameters, mechanical performance, and failure.
Connects polymer type, infill, porosity, and interface design to joint integrity.
infographic.evidence_signal: The reviewed evidence links joint quality to interacting process and structural factors, but differences in specimens and testing limit direct comparisons between techniques.
infographic.watch_item: Excessive heating can degrade or deform parts; evidence for microwave-assisted welding of separately printed components remains limited.
infographic.paper_title: Welding of thermoplastics printed by fused filament fabrication: A critical review of joining mechanisms and relationships between processing, structure, and properties

zh-Hans.title: 熔融丝材制造热塑性塑料的焊接：连接机制及工艺、结构与性能关系的批判性综述
zh-Hans.abstract: 熔融丝材制造（FFF）技术，也称为熔融沉积成型（FDM），能够制造具有复杂几何形状的热塑性塑料构件，但仍受打印机成形空间的限制。焊接可以连接分别打印的构件。然而，层状结构、填充构型、孔隙率和层间结合会影响接头的形成与强度。本文批判性地综述了用于FFF打印热塑性塑料构件的六种焊接技术：搅拌摩擦焊、搅拌摩擦点焊、旋转摩擦焊、超声波焊接、激光连接和微波辅助焊接。综述重点关注连接机制、工艺参数、材料特性、力学性能和失效机制。结果表明，接头质量取决于焊接参数、聚合物类型、填充结构、工具或界面设计以及接头构型之间的相互作用。提高工艺能量输入并不总能提高接头强度，因为过度加热可能导致热降解和变形，而材料固结不足则可能限制接头的完整性。材料、试样几何形状、接头构型和测试方法的差异仍限制了不同技术之间的直接比较。关于采用微波辅助焊接连接分别打印构件的证据也仍然有限。未来研究需要统筹打印与焊接参数，建立结构特征及缺陷与力学性能之间的关联，并提高测试与报告的一致性。这种方法对于阐明工艺、结构与性能之间的关系，以及支持开发适用于工程应用的可靠接头是必要的。

infographic.key_insight: FFF打印热塑性塑料的焊接质量取决于工艺、材料与打印结构的耦合作用，而非仅仅取决于更高的能量输入。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 焊接能够实现超出打印机成形空间限制的构件组装，但可靠接头的获得需要协同开展打印与连接设计。
method: 批判性地综述了用于FFF打印热塑性塑料的六种焊接技术。

title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings
authors: Ting XIA, Yueming WANG, Lu XIE
abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr cemented carbide coating has the advantages of superior wear property and corrosion resistance. WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were prepared on 304 stainless steel substrates by different thermal spray technologies including atmospheric plasma spraying (APS), detonation spraying (DS), high velocity oxy-fuel spraying (HVOFS), and high velocity air-fuel spraying (HVAFS), respectively. The microstructure, tribological properties and corrosion resistances of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were systematically investigated and compared. The results showed that the Vickers hardness of cemented coatings prepared by APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF, which were all higher than those of 304 stainless steel, were 771.4 HV, 954.2 HV, 1166.2 HV, and 1162.2 HV, respectively. The volume wear rate of 304 stainless steel was about (36.82±0.80)×10-5 mm3/N·m. The volume wear rates of APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF coatings, which were all lower than that of 304 stainless steel, were about (7.93±0.30)×10-5, (1.51±0.20)×10-5, (1.17±0.10)×10-5, and (1.10±0.01)×10-5 mm3/N·m, respectively. In addition, the average friction coefficients of 304 stainless steel substrate, APS coating, DS one, HVOF one and HVAF one were about (0.68±0.03), (0.56±0.02), (0.48±0.01), (0.44±0.01) and (0.43±0.01), respectively. Spalling, microcracks perpendicular to the friction direction, and grooves parallel to the friction direction can be found in the wear marks of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings. Abrasive wear and fatigue wear are the main wear mechanisms of the cemented coatings. During the wear test, the carbide particles in DS, HVOF and HVAF coatings gradually became the main body bearing the friction load. Then the wear resistance of the latter three coatings was all superior to that of APS. Moreover, HVOF and HVAF coatings have better wear performances. For corrosion resistance from high to low were HVAF coating, DS one, HVOF one and APS one, respectively. The HVAF coating demonstrated the highest corrosion potential (-0.37±0.01 VSCE), smallest corrosion current density (1.75±0.02 μA/cm²), and largest corrosion resistance (20438.5 Ω) here. The APS coating had the poorest corrosion resistance among these four coatings.

infographic.engineering_relevance: The results support HVAF as a promising coating process for 304 stainless steel components exposed to combined wear and corrosion.

zh-Hans.title: 大气等离子喷涂、爆炸喷涂、超音速氧燃料喷涂和超音速空气燃料喷涂WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层的显微组织、耐磨性和耐蚀性
zh-Hans.abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层具有优异的耐磨性和耐蚀性。采用大气等离子喷涂（APS）、爆炸喷涂（DS）、超音速氧燃料喷涂（HVOFS）和超音速空气燃料喷涂（HVAFS）等不同热喷涂技术，分别在304不锈钢基体上制备了WC-10Co-4Cr涂层。系统研究并比较了WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的显微组织、摩擦学性能和耐蚀性。结果表明，采用APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF制备的硬质合金涂层的维氏硬度分别为771.4 HV、954.2 HV、1166.2 HV和1162.2 HV，均高于304不锈钢。304不锈钢的体积磨损率约为(36.82±0.80)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)。APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层的体积磨损率分别约为(7.93±0.30)×10⁻⁵、(1.51±0.20)×10⁻⁵、(1.17±0.10)×10⁻⁵和(1.10±0.01)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)，均低于304不锈钢。此外，304不锈钢基体、APS涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和HVAF涂层的平均摩擦系数分别约为(0.68±0.03)、(0.56±0.02)、(0.48±0.01)、(0.44±0.01)和(0.43±0.01)。在WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的磨痕中可观察到剥落、垂直于摩擦方向的微裂纹以及平行于摩擦方向的沟槽。磨粒磨损和疲劳磨损是这些硬质合金涂层的主要磨损机制。在磨损试验过程中，DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层中的碳化物颗粒逐渐成为承受摩擦载荷的主体。因此，后三种涂层的耐磨性均优于APS涂层，其中HVOF和HVAF涂层的耐磨性能更佳。耐蚀性由高到低依次为HVAF涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和APS涂层。在本研究中，HVAF涂层表现出最高的腐蚀电位(-0.37±0.01 VSCE)、最低的腐蚀电流密度(1.75±0.02 μA/cm²)和最大的腐蚀电阻(20438.5 Ω)。APS涂层在这四种涂层中的耐蚀性最差。

title: Microstructure and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of HVOF and plasma sprayed Ni–Cr-based ceramic coatings on SA516 boiler steel
authors: Ankur Gill, Vikas Chawla, Amit Handa, Santosh Kumar
abstract: This study investigates the microstructural and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of SA516 boiler steel coated with Ni-20Cr, Ni-20Cr+40TiC, and Ni-20Cr+40TiN using High Velocity Oxygen Fuel (HVOF) and Plasma Spray (PS) techniques. The cyclic air oxidation tests were performed for fifty cycles at 900°C in a simulated laboratory environment, and the resulting microstructural and phase changes were analyzed by means of X-ray Diffraction (XRD), Scanning Electron Microscopy with Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (SEM/EDS), and X-ray mapping. The uncoated SA516 steel experienced intense spalling and cracking of the oxide layer, developing an unprotected phase (Fe 2 O 3 ). Among all coatings, the HVOF-sprayed Ni-20Cr+40TiC coating diminished maximum weight gain by 95.71 % compared to bare SA516 steel, indicating superior oxidation resistance. This enhanced performance of coatings is attributed to formation a dense, protective oxide layer consisting of Cr 2 O 3 , TiO 2 , NiTiO 4 , and NiO, coupled with reduced porosity and enhanced microhardness.

infographic.engineering_relevance: This coating offers a promising route to protect SA516 boiler steel against high-temperature oxidation through reduced porosity and a dense protective oxide scale.

title: Molten pool dynamic behavior and arc characteristics in laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel
authors: Sen WU, Fei ZHAO, Shuili GONG, Lifeng MA, Haiyan ZHAO, Wei ZHANG
abstract: Invar steel has an extremely low coefficient of thermal expansion, making it widely used in the manufacturing of molds for aerospace composite materials. Most existing studies focus on process aspects, lacking in-depth analysis of the fluid dynamics behavior of the molten pool. Therefore, numerical simulation and high-speed photography were employed to analyze the effects of different process parameters on the molten pool morphology evolution and arc characteristics during laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, which provides crucial theoretical support for the optimization of the Invar steel welding process. The results indicate that within the laser power range of 5 ~ 6 kW, the increased power leads to greater recoil pressure, which promotes a larger penetration depth and keyhole dimension, intensifies the overall molten pool flow, and makes the arc prone to being attracted by the laser and deflected at a high power. Within the welding speed range of 0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min, a higher speed reduces the heat input, leading to a decreased penetration depth and weld width, and an increased flow velocity and cooling rate of the molten pool; additionally, the arc is prone to deformation at a high speed. Within the welding current range of 150 ~ 170 A, the increased current enhances the arc force, promoting the expansion of weld width and intensifying the molten pool convection; furthermore, the arc is more stable at a high current.

infographic.key_insight: In laser–TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, laser power, welding speed, and current affect molten-pool flow, weld geometry, and arc stability in distinct ways.
infographic.engineering_relevance: These parameter–response relationships can guide welding-process optimization for low-expansion Invar tooling used in aerospace composite manufacturing.

zh-Hans.title: Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接中的熔池动态行为与电弧特性
zh-Hans.abstract: Invar钢具有极低的热膨胀系数，因此广泛用于航空航天复合材料成型模具的制造。现有研究大多侧重于工艺方面，缺乏对熔池流体动力学行为的深入分析。因此，采用数值模拟和高速摄影，分析了不同工艺参数对Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接过程中熔池形貌演变和电弧特性的影响，为Invar钢焊接工艺优化提供了重要的理论支持。结果表明，在5 ~ 6 kW的激光功率范围内，功率增大使反冲压力增大，从而增加熔深和小孔尺寸，加剧熔池整体流动；在高功率下，电弧易受激光吸引而发生偏转。在0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min的焊接速度范围内，速度增大使热输入降低，导致熔深和焊缝宽度减小，熔池流速和冷却速率增大；此外，在高焊接速度下，电弧易发生变形。在150 ~ 170 A的焊接电流范围内，电流增大使电弧力增强，促进焊缝宽度增大并加剧熔池对流；此外，在高电流下，电弧更加稳定。

title: INVESTIGATION OF THE FORMATION OF STRUCTURE AND WEAR-RESISTANT PROPERTIES OF WC–CO–CR COATINGS PRODUCED BY HVOF AND DETONATION SPRAYING
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, G.Zh. Zhunissova, Ermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов, Rashid Kuanyshbay
abstract: The article presents a comparative analysis of WC–Co–Cr cermet coatings deposited by detonation spray (DS) and High Velocity Oxy-Fuel (HVOF) methods. The study included an analysis of the morphology of the initial powders, as well as the microstructure and phase composition of the coatings using Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) and Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (EDS). The results show that the use of homogeneous, fully alloyed WC–Co–Cr powder ensures the formation of a dense, layered structure with a uniform distribution of the carbide phase within the metallic matrix. Detonation spraying produces a harder coating (average microhardness 1449 HV), whereas HVOF provides a coating with high density, uniform microstructure, and low friction coefficient (Kt = 0.143). The comparative analysis confirmed that the mechanical and tribological properties of the coatings strongly depend on the powder morphology and the spraying method. These findings allow for the determination of optimal processing conditions for WC–Co–Cr coatings, enhancing wear resistance and durability of machine parts, which is particularly relevant for operation under intensive friction and high load conditions.

infographic.key_insight: WC–Co–Cr coating performance depends on powder morphology and spray method: detonation spraying favors hardness, while HVOF yields dense, uniform coatings with low friction.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Powder and deposition-process selection can help tailor wear-resistant coatings for machine parts exposed to intensive friction and high loads.

title: De-Risking Robotic Welding for In-Space Metal Joining Through Physics-Grounded Digital Twins
authors: Zhou Daniel Hao, Umer Masood Chaudry, Robert Shaw, Andrew Cheney, Nick Ludford, Mark Sims
abstract: Growing interest in in-space servicing, manufacturing, and assembly has renewed attention on reliable metal joining for modular construction and on-orbit repair. Robotic welding is promising, but reduced-gravity and low-pressure operation remains poorly characterised and flight-like tests are limited. The UK Space Agency-supported ISPARK project is developing a physics-grounded digital twin for structured process de-risking. This paper evaluates a model-based prototype combining a finite-volume thermal weld-pool model, Gaussian-process (GP) and neural-network surrogates, and a simulated six-axis manipulator. The reduced model includes solid-liquid phase change, effective thermocapillary transport, and a local-pressure parameter. Gravity is assessed separately through a hydrostatic-to-capillary pressure ratio and does not enter the thermal energy equation. Across repeated five-fold cross-validation, the GP has lower normalised mean absolute error than the neural network for all eight outputs. In 10 held-out boundary cases, 74 of 80 solver responses fall within nominal 90% GP predictive intervals. A three-output GP query takes 249 microseconds, including scaling and predictive variance. In a simulated UR5 L-shaped-seam study, a proportional controller adjusts the synergic power-source setting as travel speed falls near the corner. Finite-volume re-evaluation finds all 12 closed-loop operating points and 9 of 12 open-loop points within an illustrative 1.0-3.0 mm root-side-width band. These simulation results support using the framework to screen welding conditions and control strategies before experimental tests. Thermal-vacuum, targeted reduced-gravity, and robotic hardware-in-the-loop studies are needed to assess the model and controller.

infographic.key_insight: A physics-grounded digital twin pairs weld-pool simulation with Gaussian-process surrogates to screen robotic welding conditions and control strategies for future in-space metal joining.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Fast surrogate predictions could support welding-parameter adjustment as robot travel speed changes, reducing reliance on costly flight-like testing during early development.
method: Finite-volume thermal model includes phase change, effective thermocapillary transport, and local pressure; gravity is assessed separately.
Gaussian-process and neural-network surrogates are compared using repeated five-fold cross-validation.
A simulated six-axis UR5 follows an L-shaped seam while proportional control adjusts the power-source setting.

infographic.watch_item: Results are simulation-only; thermal-vacuum, reduced-gravity, and robotic hardware-in-the-loop tests are needed to assess model and controller validity.
infographic.paper_title: De-Risking Robotic Welding for In-Space Metal Joining Through Physics-Grounded Digital Twins

zh-Hans.title: 通过基于物理的数字孪生降低用于太空金属连接的机器人焊接风险
zh-Hans.abstract: 随着人们对太空服务、制造与装配的兴趣日益增长，用于模块化建造和在轨维修的可靠金属连接技术重新受到关注。机器人焊接具有潜力，但对其在低重力和低压条件下的运行特性仍缺乏充分认识，且类飞行条件试验有限。由英国航天局支持的 ISPARK 项目正在开发一种基于物理的数字孪生，以系统化降低工艺风险。本文评估了一个基于模型的原型，该原型结合了有限体积焊接熔池热模型、高斯过程（GP）和神经网络代理模型，以及仿真六轴机械臂。该简化模型包含固液相变、有效热毛细输运和局部压力参数。重力通过静水压力与毛细压力之比单独评估，不进入热能方程。在重复五折交叉验证中，GP 在全部八个输出上的归一化平均绝对误差均低于神经网络。在 10 个留出的边界工况中，80 个求解器响应中的 74 个落在 GP 的标称 90% 预测区间内。一次三输出 GP 查询耗时 249 微秒，包括数据缩放和预测方差计算。在一项仿真 UR5 沿 L 形焊缝运动的研究中，当行进速度在拐角附近下降时，比例控制器会调整焊接电源的一元化设定。有限体积模型复核发现，全部 12 个闭环运行点和 12 个开环运行点中的 9 个位于示例性的 1.0-3.0 mm 焊缝根部宽度范围内。这些仿真结果支持在实验测试前使用该框架筛选焊接条件和控制策略。仍需开展热真空、针对性的低重力以及机器人硬件在环研究，以评估该模型和控制器。

infographic.key_insight: 基于物理的数字孪生将焊接熔池仿真与高斯过程代理模型相结合，为未来太空金属连接筛选机器人焊接条件和控制策略。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 快速代理预测可在机器人行进速度变化时支持焊接参数调整，减少早期开发阶段对昂贵的类飞行条件试验的依赖。
method: 有限体积热模型包含相变、有效热毛细输运和局部压力；重力单独评估。
采用重复五折交叉验证比较高斯过程与神经网络代理模型。
仿真六轴 UR5 沿 L 形焊缝运动，同时通过比例控制调整电源设定。
infographic.evidence_signal: GP 在全部八个输出上均优于神经网络；74/80 个留出工况的求解器响应落在标称 90% 预测区间内，有限体积模型复核显示，12/12 个闭环运行点和 9/12 个开环运行点位于示例性的焊缝根部宽度范围内。
infographic.watch_item: 结果仅来自仿真；仍需开展热真空、低重力和机器人硬件在环试验，以评估模型和控制器的有效性。

title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments
authors: Shuai Cui, Haimin Zhai, Zihan Feng, Xuqiang Li, Wensheng Li, Xiangjuan Fan
abstract: Fe-based amorphous coatings (Fe-based AMCs) were successfully prepared on Q235 carbon steel by detonation spray under different spraying parameters. The corrosion and tribology behaviors of coatings were systematically tested. The droplets show disk-like morphology with the highest circularity and expansion factor, which is crucial to reduce the defects of coatings and to form fine-lamellar-structures coatings with dense microstructure. A higher incidence of porosity defects in the coating is associated with reduced long-term corrosion resistance. Moreover, the tribo-chemical reactions between Si3N4 balls and water molecules play a significant role in wear behaviors for coating in different humidity conditions. The friction coefficient and wear rate of coatings decrease as the humidity conditions increase.

infographic.key_insight: Disk-like droplets with high circularity and expansion favor dense, fine-lamellar Fe-based amorphous coatings, while greater porosity reduces long-term corrosion resistance.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Detonation-spray process control and service humidity are important considerations for corrosion- and wear-resistant coatings on Q235 carbon steel.
method: Deposit Fe-based amorphous coatings by detonation spraying under varied parameters.
Examine droplet morphology, coating microstructure, and long-term corrosion behavior.
Evaluate friction and wear across humidity conditions using Si3N4 balls.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports poorer long-term corrosion resistance with greater porosity and decreasing friction coefficient and wear rate as humidity increases.
infographic.watch_item: The abstract provides no quantitative effect sizes or humidity ranges, and wear trends involving Si3N4 counterfaces may not transfer to other contact materials.
infographic.paper_title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments

zh-Hans.title: 不同湿度环境下铁基非晶涂层的长期腐蚀行为和磨损行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 在不同喷涂参数下，采用爆炸喷涂在Q235碳钢上成功制备了铁基非晶涂层（Fe-based AMCs）。系统测试了涂层的腐蚀行为和摩擦学行为。液滴呈盘状形貌，具有最高的圆度和铺展因子，这对于减少涂层缺陷以及形成微观组织致密的细薄层状结构涂层至关重要。涂层中孔隙缺陷越多，其长期耐腐蚀性越低。此外，Si3N4球与水分子之间的摩擦化学反应对不同湿度条件下涂层的磨损行为起着重要作用。随着湿度升高，涂层的摩擦系数和磨损率均降低。

infographic.key_insight: 具有高圆度和高铺展程度的盘状液滴有利于形成致密、细薄层状的铁基非晶涂层，而孔隙越多，长期耐腐蚀性越低。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于Q235碳钢上的耐腐蚀、耐磨涂层，爆炸喷涂工艺控制和服役环境湿度是重要的考虑因素。
method: 在不同参数下采用爆炸喷涂沉积铁基非晶涂层。
考察液滴形貌、涂层微观组织及长期腐蚀行为。
使用Si3N4球评估不同湿度条件下的摩擦和磨损。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告，孔隙越多，长期耐腐蚀性越差；随着湿度升高，摩擦系数和磨损率均降低。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要未提供定量效应大小或湿度范围，且使用Si3N4对偶材料时观察到的磨损趋势可能不适用于其他接触材料。

title: EFFECT OF FLAME-SPRAYING TEMPERATURE ON THE PROPERTIES OF Ni–Cr–B–Si-BASED SELF-FLUXING COATINGS
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Manarbek Kylyshkanov, Daryn Baizhan, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Nurkhat Bimakhan
abstract: The present study investigates the effect of flame-spraying process parameters on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings. Corrosion-resistant AISI 321 austenitic chromium–nickel steel was used as the substrate material. The coatings were deposited by flame spraying using a Metal Coat 6PM-II system. To vary the thermal conditions of the spraying process, the oxygen-to-acetylene (O₂/C₂H₂) ratio was adjusted to 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2. The spraying parameters were monitored using an Accuraspray 4.0 diagnostic system. The resulting coatings were characterized in terms of microstructure, porosity, microhardness, surface roughness, and adhesion strength. Increasing the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio resulted in densification of the coating structure and a decrease in porosity from 1.97 ± 0.13% to 0.90 ± 0.09%. Concurrently, the surface roughness decreased from 4.70 ± 0.09 μm to 2.99 ± 0.11 μm, while the adhesion strength increased from 22.14 ± 4.3 MPa to 35.02 ± 3.9 MPa. The highest average microhardness of 1051.7 HV was obtained at an O₂/C₂H₂ ratio of 1.1. Among the investigated spraying conditions, the coating produced at O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2 exhibited the lowest porosity and surface roughness together with the highest adhesion strength. The results demonstrate that controlling the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio provides an effective means of tailoring the microstructural and mechanical characteristics of flame-sprayed Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings.
venue: Journal of Surface Engineering and Coating Technology

infographic.key_insight: Increasing the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio improved coating density, smoothness, and adhesion, while peak microhardness occurred at the intermediate ratio of 1.1.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Gas-ratio control offers a practical way to tailor Ni–Cr–B–Si flame-sprayed coatings on AISI 321 steel to different performance priorities.

zh-Hans.title: 火焰喷涂温度对Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了火焰喷涂工艺参数对Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层微观组织和力学性能的影响。采用耐腐蚀的AISI 321奥氏体铬镍钢作为基体材料，使用Metal Coat 6PM-II系统通过火焰喷涂制备涂层。为改变喷涂过程的热条件，将氧气与乙炔的比值（O₂/C₂H₂）分别调整为1.0、1.1和1.2。采用Accuraspray 4.0诊断系统监测喷涂参数。对所得涂层的微观组织、孔隙率、显微硬度、表面粗糙度和结合强度进行了表征。提高O₂/C₂H₂比值使涂层组织更加致密，孔隙率从1.97 ± 0.13%降至0.90 ± 0.09%。同时，表面粗糙度从4.70 ± 0.09 μm降至2.99 ± 0.11 μm，结合强度从22.14 ± 4.3 MPa增至35.02 ± 3.9 MPa。当O₂/C₂H₂比值为1.1时，获得了最高平均显微硬度，为1051.7 HV。在所研究的喷涂条件中，O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2时制备的涂层具有最低的孔隙率和表面粗糙度，以及最高的结合强度。结果表明，控制O₂/C₂H₂比值是调控火焰喷涂Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层微观组织和力学特性的有效手段。

infographic.key_insight: 提高O₂/C₂H₂比值改善了涂层的致密性、平滑度和结合强度，而显微硬度在中间比值1.1时达到峰值。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 通过控制气体比值，可切实调控AISI 321钢表面的Ni–Cr–B–Si火焰喷涂涂层，以满足不同的性能侧重点。
method: 使用Metal Coat 6PM-II火焰喷涂系统，在O₂/C₂H₂比值分别为1.0、1.1和1.2的条件下制备涂层。
使用Accuraspray 4.0诊断系统监测喷涂参数。
表征微观组织、孔隙率、显微硬度、表面粗糙度和结合强度。
infographic.evidence_signal: 当比值从1.0增至1.2时，孔隙率从1.97 ± 0.13%降至0.90 ± 0.09%，粗糙度从4.70 ± 0.09 μm降至2.99 ± 0.11 μm，结合强度从22.14 ± 4.3 MPa增至35.02 ± 3.9 MPa；当比值为1.1时，平均显微硬度达到峰值1051.7 HV。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要仅涵盖一种基体上的三种气体比值，未报告长期磨损或腐蚀试验。

title: Enhancing weld performance of AA2024-T351 using drilled-to-bossed geometry and deep learning prediction in direct drive friction welding
authors: Eyob Messele Sefene, Alemayehu Admas Abay, Akshansh Mishra, Assefa Asmare Tsegaw, William Gomez, Addisalem Desalegn Sisay
abstract: Abstract The growing demand for lightweight, high-strength materials in the aerospace and automotive industries has brought aluminium alloys such as AA2024-T351 into the spotlight due to their outstanding strength-to-weight ratio. However, achieving reliable joints in such alloys remains a significant challenge, particularly when using conventional welding techniques. To address this, the present study focuses on optimizing process parameters in Direct Drive Friction Welding (DDFW) for AA2024-T351. A novel drilled-to-bossed geometry, inspired by the traditional mortise-and-tenon joint, is introduced to enhance mechanical interlocking and improve weld integrity. Experimental trials were systematically designed using an L18 orthogonal array to evaluate both tensile and torsional strength. The experiments were conducted on a customized engine lathe, with friction pressure, forging pressure, spindle speed, faying surface geometry, and friction time selected as the controllable process parameters. In parallel, advanced deep learning models, including an ensemble residual network, a compact attention network, and an adaptive multiscale network, were implemented to predict ultimate tensile strength based on the welding conditions. The results revealed that the optimal parameter combination of 30 MPa friction pressure, 70 MPa forging pressure, 2200 rpm spindle speed, drilled-to-bossed geometry, and 4 min of friction time yielded exceptional mechanical performance, achieving a tensile strength of 538 MPa and torsional strength of 325 MPa. The drilled-to-bossed configuration demonstrated significantly higher joint strength compared to conventional flat-to-flat joints. Moreover, among the deep learning models, the ensemble residual network achieved the highest predictive accuracy with an R² value of approximately 0.81, effectively capturing the complex relationship between process parameters and weld strength.

infographic.key_insight: Drilled-to-bossed geometry improved AA2024-T351 friction-weld strength over flat-to-flat joints, while an ensemble residual network predicted tensile strength with R² ≈ 0.81.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Combining mechanical interlocking with process-parameter optimization could improve aluminium joint reliability for lightweight aerospace and automotive structures.
method: Tested direct drive friction welding on a customized engine lathe using an L18 orthogonal array.
Varied friction pressure, forging pressure, spindle speed, faying geometry, and friction time.
Compared ensemble residual, compact attention, and adaptive multiscale networks for tensile-strength prediction.
infographic.evidence_signal: The reported optimum—30 MPa friction pressure, 70 MPa forging pressure, 2200 rpm, drilled-to-bossed geometry, and 4 min friction time—achieved 538 MPa tensile strength and 325 MPa torsional strength.
infographic.watch_item: The abstract does not specify model-validation procedures or independent test data, leaving predictive generalization beyond the experimental conditions uncertain.
infographic.paper_title: Enhancing weld performance of AA2024-T351 using drilled-to-bossed geometry and deep learning prediction in direct drive friction welding

zh-Hans.title: 利用钻孔端—凸台端几何构型与深度学习预测提升AA2024-T351直接驱动摩擦焊的焊接性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 航空航天和汽车行业对轻质高强材料的需求日益增长，使AA2024-T351等铝合金因其出色的强度重量比而备受关注。然而，在此类合金中获得可靠接头仍是一项重大挑战，尤其是在采用传统焊接技术时。为此，本研究重点优化AA2024-T351直接驱动摩擦焊（DDFW）的工艺参数。受传统榫卯接头启发，研究引入了一种新型钻孔端—凸台端几何构型，以增强机械互锁并改善焊缝完整性。采用L18正交表系统设计试验，以评估抗拉强度和抗扭强度。试验在一台定制改装的普通车床上进行，选取摩擦压力、顶锻压力、主轴转速、接合面几何形状和摩擦时间作为可控工艺参数。同时，采用集成残差网络、紧凑型注意力网络和自适应多尺度网络等先进深度学习模型，根据焊接条件预测极限抗拉强度。结果表明，摩擦压力30 MPa、顶锻压力70 MPa、主轴转速2200 rpm、钻孔端—凸台端几何构型以及摩擦时间4 min的最优参数组合产生了优异的力学性能，抗拉强度达到538 MPa，抗扭强度达到325 MPa。与传统平面端—平面端接头相比，钻孔端—凸台端构型表现出显著更高的接头强度。此外，在所采用的深度学习模型中，集成残差网络的预测精度最高，R²值约为0.81，有效捕捉了工艺参数与焊缝强度之间的复杂关系。

infographic.key_insight: 与平面端—平面端接头相比，钻孔端—凸台端几何构型提高了AA2024-T351摩擦焊接头的强度；同时，集成残差网络预测抗拉强度的R²约为0.81。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 将机械互锁与工艺参数优化相结合，有望提高用于轻量化航空航天和汽车结构的铝合金接头的可靠性。
method: 采用L18正交表，在定制改装的普通车床上开展直接驱动摩擦焊试验。
改变摩擦压力、顶锻压力、主轴转速、接合面几何形状和摩擦时间。
比较集成残差网络、紧凑型注意力网络和自适应多尺度网络在抗拉强度预测中的表现。
infographic.evidence_signal: 所报告的最优条件为摩擦压力30 MPa、顶锻压力70 MPa、主轴转速2200 rpm、钻孔端—凸台端几何构型以及摩擦时间4 min，在该条件下抗拉强度达到538 MPa，抗扭强度达到325 MPa。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要未说明模型验证程序或独立测试数据，因此模型在试验条件之外的预测泛化能力仍不确定。

title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
authors: Vyacheslav Sirota, Sergey Savotchenko, Valeriya Strokova, Daniil Podgornyi, Marina Kovaleva
abstract: The surface properties of metal-ceramic coatings based on titanium dioxide are described in dependence on the detonation spraying conditions. It is found that such properties as surface roughness, surface thickness and its hydrophobicity can be controlled in the production process by selecting certain values of the technological parameters of the spraying process. The optimal values of the technological parameters of detonation spraying, ensuring maximum hydrophobicity of the produced coatings are determined. The roughness of the coating surface and the coating thickness depend on the speed of the nozzle passage in accordance with the inverse power law. The roughness and the contact angle depend on spray distance in accordance with a parabolic law. New equations are obtained that can be useful for predicting the characteristics of the coating surface, as well as for determining the optimal mode of spraying the coating, ensuring its best hydrophobicity.
venue: Iranian Journal of Materials Science and Engineering

infographic.key_insight: Detonation spraying parameters can tune titanium dioxide–based coating roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity, with optimal conditions identified for maximum hydrophobicity.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The reported relationships can guide spraying parameter selection to achieve targeted coating surface properties.
method: Vary detonation spraying conditions for titanium dioxide–based metal-ceramic coatings.
Evaluate surface roughness, coating thickness, and contact angle.
Derive predictive equations and identify conditions maximizing hydrophobicity.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports inverse power-law relationships between nozzle passage speed and both roughness and thickness, plus parabolic relationships between spray distance and both roughness and contact angle.
infographic.watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical optimal settings, parameter ranges, or prediction errors, limiting direct process implementation.
infographic.paper_title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions

zh-Hans.title: 不同工艺条件下爆炸喷涂制备的钛基涂层的表面特征
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文描述了二氧化钛基金属陶瓷涂层的表面性能与爆炸喷涂条件之间的关系。研究发现，通过选取喷涂工艺参数的特定值，可以在制备过程中调控表面粗糙度、表面层厚度及其疏水性等性能。确定了使所制备涂层疏水性达到最大的爆炸喷涂工艺参数最优值。涂层表面粗糙度和涂层厚度随喷嘴移动速度的变化遵循反幂律关系。粗糙度和接触角随喷涂距离的变化遵循抛物线关系。获得了新的方程，可用于预测涂层表面特征，并确定使涂层疏水性达到最佳的喷涂工艺条件。

infographic.key_insight: 爆炸喷涂参数可调控二氧化钛基涂层的粗糙度、厚度和疏水性，研究确定了使疏水性达到最大的最优条件。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 所报告的关系可指导喷涂参数的选择，以获得目标涂层表面性能。
method: 改变二氧化钛基金属陶瓷涂层的爆炸喷涂条件。
评估表面粗糙度、涂层厚度和接触角。
推导预测方程，并确定使疏水性达到最大的条件。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告，喷嘴移动速度与粗糙度及厚度均呈反幂律关系，喷涂距离与粗糙度及接触角均呈抛物线关系。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要未提供最优参数设置的具体数值、参数范围或预测误差，限制了其在工艺中的直接应用。

title: HARDNESS AND POST-SCRATCH SURFACE MORPHOLOGY OF Cr₃C₂–NiCr COATINGS AFTER ULTRASONIC NANOCRYSTAL SURFACE MODIFICATION
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, Indira Abizhanova, M.K. Kaliaskarova, Yermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов
abstract: The hardness and post-scratch surface morphology of Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings subjected to ultrasonic nanocrystal surface modification (UNSM) were examined for detonation-sprayed (DS) and high-velocity oxy-fuel (HVOF) deposits. Four treated samples per deposition route were evaluated at static loads of 20 and 30 N and vibration amplitudes of 20 and 30 µm. Instrumental hardness was measured at a load of 300 mN with a dwell time of 10 s. The DS samples exhibited hardness values of 820–970 HV, whereas the HVOF samples covered the wider range of 546–1165 HV. The highest values were recorded for DS-T1 at 20 N/20 µm and HVOF-T4 at 30 N/30 µm. SEM fields acquired after scratch testing showed heterogeneous surface contrast and crack-like discontinuities in both coating series. These observations provide qualitative evidence of the post-test surface condition but do not isolate damage caused by UNSM or establish a ranking of scratch resistance. Available mean friction coefficients are reported as supplementary observations for six treated samples. The results demonstrate a sample-dependent hardness response and emphasize the need to assess local mechanical properties together with surface integrity.
venue: Journal of Surface Engineering and Coating Technology

infographic.key_insight: UNSM-treated Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings showed sample-dependent hardness, with peak values of 970 HV for detonation-sprayed deposits and 1165 HV for HVOF deposits.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Coating process and UNSM settings should be evaluated together with local hardness and surface integrity rather than hardness alone.
method: Evaluated four UNSM-treated samples per deposition route: detonation spray and HVOF.
Used static loads of 20–30 N and vibration amplitudes of 20–30 µm.
Measured instrumental hardness at 300 mN with a 10 s dwell and examined post-scratch surfaces by SEM.
infographic.evidence_signal: Hardness ranged from 820–970 HV for detonation-sprayed coatings and 546–1165 HV for HVOF coatings, peaking at 20 N/20 µm and 30 N/30 µm, respectively.
infographic.watch_item: Post-scratch SEM observations do not isolate UNSM-induced damage or establish a scratch-resistance ranking.

zh-Hans.title: 超声纳米晶表面改性后Cr₃C₂–NiCr涂层的硬度及划痕后表面形貌
zh-Hans.abstract: 研究了经超声纳米晶表面改性（UNSM）处理的爆炸喷涂（DS）和超音速火焰喷涂（HVOF）Cr₃C₂–NiCr涂层的硬度及划痕后表面形貌。针对每种沉积工艺，在20和30 N静载荷以及20和30 µm振动振幅条件下，对四个处理后样品进行了评估。在300 mN载荷、10 s保载时间下测量了仪器化压入硬度。DS样品的硬度为820–970 HV，而HVOF样品的硬度范围更宽，为546–1165 HV。DS-T1在20 N/20 µm条件下、HVOF-T4在30 N/30 µm条件下分别获得各自系列的最高硬度值。划痕试验后获取的SEM视场显示，两组涂层均存在不均匀的表面对比度和裂纹状不连续特征。这些观察结果为试验后表面状态提供了定性证据，但无法单独识别UNSM造成的损伤，也无法据此确定耐划伤性能的排序。六个处理后样品已有的平均摩擦系数作为补充观察结果予以报告。结果表明，硬度响应因样品而异，并强调有必要结合表面完整性评估局部力学性能。

infographic.key_insight: 经UNSM处理的Cr₃C₂–NiCr涂层的硬度因样品而异，爆炸喷涂涂层和HVOF涂层的峰值硬度分别为970 HV和1165 HV。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 应结合局部硬度和表面完整性评估涂层工艺与UNSM参数，而非仅依据硬度。
method: 针对爆炸喷涂和HVOF两种沉积工艺，分别评估了四个经UNSM处理的样品。
采用20–30 N静载荷和20–30 µm振动振幅。
在300 mN载荷、10 s保载时间下测量仪器化压入硬度，并通过SEM检查划痕后表面。
infographic.evidence_signal: 爆炸喷涂涂层的硬度范围为820–970 HV，HVOF涂层为546–1165 HV，分别在20 N/20 µm和30 N/30 µm条件下达到峰值。
infographic.watch_item: 划痕后的SEM观察无法单独识别UNSM引起的损伤，也无法据此确定耐划伤性能的排序。
